summary: Klamath County site listed under Rogue River National Forest; described in 1959 as an undeveloped emergency and patrol observation point.

events.note: Undeveloped site used as an emergency and patrol observation point

evidence.supports: county heading for the Summit Rock entry is Klamath County

evidence.quote: 1959: This undeveloped site was used as an emergency and patrol observation point.

notes_for_editor: One source: the Forest Lookouts Oregon page, which gives one dated line. Story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence is one line; it was not padded. Two WebSearch queries and a firelookout.org Oregon list check found no other record of a lookout or observation point here. TopoQuest search snippets show natural summits named Summit Rock in Klamath County with no lookout tie, so they are not used. The brief's coordinates (43.0928, -122.0764) were not checked against a land record. Kind is left unknown: the page says undeveloped but names no equipment.
